# Anne Shirley & Marilla Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — good friends · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)</sub>
- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Mentor of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Relative of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — guardian who took her to bring up · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to discover that an orphan girl was sent instead of a boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bursts into tears upon realizing she is not wanted, but stays for supper and is put to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly suggests keeping her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into emotional tears of relief. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, sending her up to her room after several conversations about imagination and potential friends.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, to Anne's disappointment over their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday-school alone, where she feels out of place in Miss Rogerson's class. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of her day, the lesson, and the church service.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly hit it off and vow to be lifelong bosom friends. After returning home overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a sweet gift of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside late after talking to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) if she can attend the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a basket for the event, which prompts a warm caress from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends the rest of the week enthusiastically dreaming about the picnic and admiring Marilla's amethyst brooch.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to invent a false confession in a desperate attempt to attend the picnic. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch snagged on her own shawl, she realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was innocent and sends her to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful day and recounts the picnic events to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake, forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the false confession, and sends her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful time and tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) all about the events, including ice cream and a boat ride. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the entire incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), reflecting on Anne's unique nature.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together, discussing their classmates and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During afternoon lessons, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in fury. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she furiously refuses Gilbert's apology after school.
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for being late, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs up her things and refuses to return to school. Upon Mrs. Rachel Lynde's advice, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay home and study on her own, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to hold a fierce grudge against [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while imagining a tragic future without [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at home for the afternoon and allows her to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and raspberry cordial. After spending time in the orchard, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unknowingly serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes she purposefully got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accused her of making [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to check the pantry and realize [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to persuade Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness, but she is cold and refuses to let [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) play with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. A distraught [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) quietly softens with sympathy as she checks on the sleeping child later that night.
>

> When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) comes down with severe croup while her parents are away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings a doctor, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's friendship.
>

> After discussing her predicament with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping into her bed. Anne's honest confession and earnest defense of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who laughs, agrees to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her first year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds her for a few minor household blunders. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the Barrys', [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses her terrifying imaginary hauntings in the spruce wood. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) in the dark to break her of the delusion.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) beautifully decorates the tea table for Mr. and Mrs. Allan's visit, and even [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is persuaded to join them. However, when Mrs. Allan tries Anne's cake, they discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.

After worrying over her manners and the weather, she attends the tea and returns home delighted, sharing the details of her visit and the news of Avonlea's new female teacher with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

> At Diana's party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts the dare, loses her balance, and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the doctor puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on several weeks of bed rest.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly grows fond of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities and Miss Stacy's project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warm encouragement.
>

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks stylish clothes like her schoolmates, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to give her a fashionable dress for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward attempt to shop himself, he enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to make a brown gloria dress with puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her concert night a resounding success.
>

Inspired by their discussion, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps start a story club with her friends. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club's stories, morals, and personal growth with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off completely. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with the shame of her shingled hair at school and vows to focus on being good rather than beautiful.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatizes Elaine with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby, but the flat leaks and she is forced to cling to a bridge pile while the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in his dory, but when he asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly refuses him. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the dangerous mishap, though [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) privately encourages her not to give up all her romance.

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to support Anne's joining the class, which delights [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The Queen's class is formed, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels saddened by Diana's absence and finds herself in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while privately regretting her past grudge against him.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offering pragmatic advice before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md). At the hotel, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. Friends and neighbors gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share their deep grief together. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues processing her sorrow with Mrs. Allan and sits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who speaks of her upcoming eye exam and past romance with John Blythe.

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns she must give up reading and sewing to save her eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives up her scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to stay home, teach at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) surrenders the position for her, and save the farm. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finally reconcile their rivalry, becoming close friends as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces her new future.

> While returning from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) spot a cow ruining Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells the animal to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) on the spot. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow instead.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the news calmly and agrees to accept Anne's cow in exchange. They share tea and cake, bonding despite insults from Mr. Harrison's foul-mouthed parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to share the happy outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their different philosophies on teaching and discipline the evening before the school term begins. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to avoid corporal punishment. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her first day of teaching with encouragement and ginger tea from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she is writing and studying, and the two talk about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the dying Mrs. Keith and her twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take the children in.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed after complaining about [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and carries the toad out to the cherry orchard on a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confronts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about his dishonesty and his decision to test Marilla's warning by skipping his prayers. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the story with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) downstairs, and the two discuss Davy's mischief compared to Dora's good behavior, agreeing that they both feel a special affection for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) despite his faults.
>

> In a miserable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to explode in the stove and losing her temper enough to whip [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. That evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To Anne's surprise, the punishment earns Anthony's respect, as later confirmed when he behaves pleasantly and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares his approval.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She excitedly prepares a special menu, cleans the house meticulously, and enlists the help of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for the event.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eagerly decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare a elaborate dinner for the arrival of famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and other guests. A series of mishaps ensues: [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the peas are ruined by too much sugar, and Miss Barry's expensive platter gets broken. A letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later explains that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disappointed but resilient.
>

> After their guests leave, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) clean up, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to an injury. Sitting on the porch, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the day's disappointments, how to resolve the broken platter, and neighborhood gossip before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed after answering his curious questions about sleep and jam. Later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and tells her where they might find a willow-ware platter to replace Aunt Josephine's. The next day, the two girls drive to the Copp farm on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally falls through the roof of a duck house while trying to look in the pantry window, leaving her stuck until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bedtime-talks with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their village improvement society's progress and upcoming plans. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md) while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes off with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to do chores. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is changing a feather bed, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Despite accidentally dyeing her nose red with rug dye beforehand, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) manages to clean herself up, borrow food from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and entertain her guests with a pleasant dinner and a walk through the woods.
>

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) repeatedly scolds [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his poor table manners. Later, news arrives that the twins' uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), has passed away and left money for their care, securing their future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to spend an evening with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. Over tea and candy, Miss Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond.
>

> Uncle Abe's weather prediction unexpectedly comes true when a destructive hail and lightning storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and buildings. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins weather the fury of the tempest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before assessing the community-wide destruction, which includes the loss of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when a well-dressed woman arrives in a wagon looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). The visitor reveals she is Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), and leaves to go to his house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the surprise, and later [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) add further details about Emily's return.

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the background of his marital separation and how his late parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) led to their split before [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her own regrets about being too hasty, while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses the Harrisons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
